WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' OR d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctl_net AS gap
FROM weekly w JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       SUM(r.net_sales) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week IN (6,7,8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, s.store_id, w.status, w.web_order_id,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS dup_n
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT (store_id=900) AS is_web, status, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(net_amount) AS net, MAX(dup_n) AS max_dup, SUM(CASE WHEN dup_n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_lines
FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS dup_n,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no, product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc, store_key) AS exact_n,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS ids
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows, SUM(net_amount) AS net_in_dup_rows, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx,
       MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, SUM(CASE WHEN exact_n=dup_n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_dups, MAX(ids) AS max_ids
FROM x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.sale_date
WHERE dup_n>1 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS amt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_store, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_prod,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS s999, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS zz,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND w.status IN ('delivered','collected')
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-29' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_net), SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp,
       CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS ordered,
       fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(order_total_gross) AS gross
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) IN (DATE '2026-06-18', DATE '2026-06-22', DATE '2026-06-23')
  AND status IN ('delivered','collected')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
